name: formbay-jobs-demo
description: Demo MCP app: list and create fake Formbay PV jobs, shown as an interactive table in chat.

interface.shortDescription: List and create fake Formbay jobs with a visual table.
interface.longDescription: A demo MCP app with fake data. The list_jobs and create_job tools return results that ChatGPT renders as an interactive jobs table, using the MCP Apps UI standard. No login and no real Formbay data.
